items.text: Foghorn booms by itself whenever there's fog, every half minute
Heard from every house in the village
Tue night: Agnes awake, window open, 10 p.m. – 3 a.m.
Clear, starry night; foghorn never sounded once
Wed: yacht's brass barometer gone; someone rowed out by dinghy in the night

items.name: Captain Quill
items.text: night watch at the harbour office with 2 crew, 10 till dawn

items.name: Tamsin
items.text: at her sister's in town; first bus back

items.name: Mr Keast
items.text: visitor; admired the yacht's brass all week
“Home all night. Thick fog. Foghorn kept me awake, booming.”

solution.text: No fog, no booming: Agnes heard silence all night. Keast invented the fog.
